Text: And after Astrid, you want us to open the door to strangers?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: No. I want us to open it to the right strangers.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Every one of them watched, tested and judged. By the Listener. Not by me.

Speaker: Player
Text: Agreed. We rebuild.
Notes: Option 1 von 3 → 030_70; im ESP vorerst: Veyra antwortet direkt mit 030_72/73 (INFO 000845), Fragment → Stage 40; Nazir 030_70/71 folgt als Szene

Speaker: Player
Text: What's in it for you?
Notes: Option 2 von 3

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A family. A home that doesn't burn. And one day, perhaps, a name on a wall that someone bothers to remember.

Speaker: Player
Text: A test wouldn't have exposed Astrid.
Notes: Option 3 von 3; Redaktion 26.09.2026: Haltung/Subtext vertieft; CSV voraus, Plugin-Abgleich offen.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Perhaps not. A test is a beginning. Watch what they do once they believe they've passed.
Notes: Redaktion 26.09.2026: Haltung/Subtext vertieft; CSV voraus, Plugin-Abgleich offen.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: ...Contracts are scarce anyway. Fine. She answers to the Listener, and I keep my scimitar sharp.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: I would expect nothing less.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: One more thing. One of your walls is not what it pretends to be. Someone went to considerable trouble over it.
Notes: E24: Text ohne Geroell, bereitet 040_12 vor

Speaker: Veyra
Text: If we mean to build a family, we'll need somewhere to put it.
Notes: → Stage 40

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Help me with this. Stone remembers pressure better than flesh does.
Notes: DEPRECATED (E24: Schleier statt Geroell, ersetzt durch 040_10-12). Am Geroell; Spieler aktiviert Geroell, Zellwechsel in die Deep Sanctuary. Redaktion E23: keine unbestätigte Alters- oder Körpergeschichte.

Speaker: Player
Text: You have opened doors like this before?
Notes: DEPRECATED (E24: Schleier statt Geroell, ersetzt durch 040_10-12).

Speaker: Veyra
Text: I have stood before many doors. Opening them is rarely the difficult part.
Notes: DEPRECATED (E24: Schleier statt Geroell, ersetzt durch 040_10-12).

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The difficult part is deciding who should hear what waits beyond.
Notes: DEPRECATED (E24: Schleier statt Geroell, ersetzt durch 040_10-12).

Speaker: Veyra
Text: This wall is lying. Stone does not hum like that. A veil, old and patient, over a doorway.
Notes: E24: Szene A (NHV_Scn_Q00_02VeiledPassage) an der Wand, Phase 1; ersetzt 040_01, 040_03-05; Urheber des Schleiers bewusst offen

Speaker: Nazir
Text: All this time we slept beside it, and the elf finds it first. Wonderful.
Notes: Szene A Phase 2

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Illusion is my trade, Nazir. Walls that pretend are the easiest to see through. Stand back.
Notes: Szene A Phase 3; danach bannt sie die Verschleierung, die Tuer erscheint (Szenenende)

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Nordic. Older than the sanctuary above. Someone sealed this for a reason.
Notes: Szene 2 Phase 1: Veyra prüft die enthüllte Tür.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: If this place kills us, I am blaming the elf.
Notes: Szene 2 Phase 2: Nazir sichert den Durchgang.

Speaker: Babette
Text: You already blame me for everything else. Let her have a turn.
Notes: Szene 2 Phase 2: Babette folgt und stichelt.

Speaker: Cicero
Text: New halls! New echoes! Cicero approves of the echoes!
Notes: Szene 2 Phase 3: nur bei lebendem Cicero.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Stay close. Old stone has a talent for making a family feel alone.
Notes: Szene 2 Phase 3: Veyra sammelt die Gruppe.

Speaker: Player
Text: Then we enter together.
Notes: Szene 2 Phase 4: Spieler bestätigt den gemeinsamen Eintritt.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: Together, then. Keep your eyes open and your hands where I can see them.
Notes: Szene 2 Phase 4: gemeinsame Bewegung zur Tür.

Speaker: Babette
Text: How touching. Try not to make a habit of it.
Notes: Szene 2 Phase 4: gemeinsame Bewegung zur Tür.

Speaker: Cicero
Text: Cicero will bring the laughter! The dark hates an empty room!
Notes: Szene 2 Phase 4: nur bei lebendem Cicero.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Let the dark keep its room. We have work to do.
Notes: Szene 2 Phase 5: Gruppe überschreitet die Schwelle.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Well. Now we know the reason.
Notes: Nach dem Kampf gegen die Draugr

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A long table. A fire pit. Imagine it full.
Notes: Hall of Whispers

Speaker: Veyra
Text: This room will do for me. Quiet walls, a desk, and people who have not learned my habits yet.
Notes: Ledger Room; Redaktion E23: freiwilliges Bleiben statt Besitzanspruch.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Beds for a dozen. If we do this right, we'll need every one. If we fail, dust needs less room.
Notes: Initiates' Dormitory

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A builder's record? Read it. I like to know who dug the hole I'm going to die in.
Notes: Buch "Builder's Record of the Dawnstar Vaults" aufgehoben

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Festus. Gabriella. Arnbjorn. Veezara. I'll carve their names myself.

Speaker: Player
Text: You knew them all?

Speaker: Veyra
Text: I know their names. That is enough to begin.
Notes: Redaktion E23: Erinnerung ohne erfundene intime Biografie.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The dead cannot correct a story. That is why I keep mine small.
Notes: Redaktion E23: Veyra bleibt fehlbar und begrenzt.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: You plan to fill this wall before we fill the beds.
Notes: Nachfrage nach der Memorial-Wahl.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: The wall is for those we lost. The beds are for those we may yet find.

Speaker: Babette
Text: Fill the beds, then. I have had quite enough of empty chairs.
Notes: Nur wenn Babette in der Sanctuary anwesend ist.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: A mess can be cleaned. An empty room is more stubborn.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: And Cicero. I owed the Keeper more than a chisel. It's all I have left to give.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: And Astrid? She led them. She also sold them. Your call, Listener.

Speaker: Player
Text: Carve her name with the others.
Notes: Option 1 von 3 → NHV_AstridMemorial = 1

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Mercy for the dead. The dead rarely deserve it, but they never complain.

Speaker: Player
Text: Leave her off.
Notes: Option 2 von 3 → NHV_AstridMemorial = 2

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Forgotten, then. The Void will remember her. We needn't.

Speaker: Player
Text: Carve it beneath the others. Smaller.
Notes: Option 3 von 3 → NHV_AstridMemorial = 3

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Remembered, but not honored. I like the way you think.

Speaker: Nazir
Text: You carved her name. You're a better person than me, Listener. That's not a compliment.
Notes: Einmalig nach Stage 60 im Sanctuary

Speaker: Nazir
Text: Good. Let the Void have her. We have enough ghosts.
Notes: Einmalig

Speaker: Nazir
Text: Small letters, low on the stone. Fitting. I'd have used a smaller chisel.
Notes: Einmalig

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Before Falkreath burned, the Night Mother heard a prayer from Hjaalmarch. A Black Sacrament.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: No one answered it. There was no one left to answer.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Let's find out what became of the one who performed it.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Take my ledger. Everything I know about our first candidate is in there. Try not to bleed on it.
Notes: Gibt "The Gleaner's Ledger" (I) → Stage 100, Q01 startet

Speaker: Player
Text: What about the initiates who are already here?
Notes: Optional, nur wenn Vanilla-Initiates in der Sanctuary vorhanden sind

Speaker: Veyra
Text: They found the door by luck, not judgment. Luck is a fine thing. Judgment lasts longer.
Notes: Konzept/Skript schreibt "judgement" (britisch) an einer Stelle; auf amerikanische Schreibweise korrigiert (E12, docs/DIALOGUE.md)

Speaker: Veyra
Text: I'll keep an eye on them.
